NUTRITIONAL IMPLICATIONS Th e nutritional implica-
tions of anemia include fatigue, depression, and diﬃ  culty in 
physical exertion leading to poor oral intake. Tasks of daily living,
including shopping and food preparation, may become more 
taxing. Appetite may be depressed. Iron supplements themselves
cause constipation, bloating, and cramping, and depress intake. 
Administration of iron supplements may lead to nutritional is-
sues if competition with other divalent cations occurs.
